question: Why is a mind absorbed in yogic spirituality not an accomplishing characteristic?
premises: A yogic-spiritual mental orientation is negated
It is not an accomplishing characteristic
inference: Mere yogic or spiritual mental absorption does not constitute the accomplishing mark sought.
uncertainties: The forms adhyāta and cittaḥ are non-standard or compressed in this text.
plain_english: It is not a mind absorbed in yoga and spiritual practice, nor is it an accomplishing characteristic.
